title: [Audit] 🎛️ Command Center
description: Entry point for Cloud Audit Dashboards. KPIs, volume, actor risk and the live signal feed.

config.content:
### See who did what across your Elastic Cloud projects

This overview shows how much activity there was, who was busiest, which identities carry the most risk, and the latest events as they arrive.

Start here for a routine review or when something looks wrong, then use the links above to go deeper on one person, sign-ins, Kibana objects, data access, security or location.

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Identity type, Identity or Client IP in the controls to focus every panel, and set the time picker. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

- Risk is weight × events, from 10 for a workflow run to 50 for a security change, so it runs far above event counts.
- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown; a Cloud API key is shortened to the start of its id, “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”.
- The links above carry the time range and filter pills to the next page, but no dropdown choice: pick again there.
- Click a Principal id to filter the page or open Actor 360; a Cloud API key’s id also covers the API keys it created.
- In the Live signal feed, a Client IP in 100.64/10 or a private range is Kibana or the platform acting for someone, not where they are.
- The last time bucket is partial, and panels side by side can differ by an event or two at the edges of the range.

config.description: Every audited event in range, routine machine traffic included. Compare with Signal events to see how much the noise gate removes. The line above the number compares it with the prior period of the same length.

Events left after the noise gate removes routine traffic: health checks, the background requests behind searches and page loads, API key lookups, bulk sign-in records and these dashboards' own activity.

?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards" OR elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "cluster:monitor/xpack/esql/*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/project/tags", "cluster:monitor/xpack/inference/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/get", "cluster:admin/xpack/security/api_key/query"))) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (event.action == "http_request" AND url.original IS NOT NULL AND url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/((internal|translations|app)/.*|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet).*|bootstrap(-anonymous)?[.]js.*|api/(core|licensing|banners|ui_counters)/.*|api/spaces/space([?].*)?)|https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/api/(saved_objects/(_import|_export)|[^?]*/(elastic_)?cloud-audit-).*") OR (kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL AND ((event.action == "saved_object_get" AND kibana.saved_object.type IN ("config","config-global")) OR (event.action == "saved_object_find" AND kibana.saved_object.type == "index-pattern"))) OR (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND (event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") OR kibana.session.id IS NULL)))) | STATS `Signal events` = COUNT(*)

config.content:
### How to read this suite

**Routine traffic is left out** unless a panel title says *all traffic*. That covers health checks, the background requests behind each search and page load, API key lookups, bulk sign-in records, and these dashboards' own activity.

**Each identity is named as in the Identity dropdown:** an email, an API key's name, or the account name.

**Cloud API keys have no name**, so tables show the start of their ID, such as `_4KEO… · Cloud API key`. An Elasticsearch key used through Kibana reads *Unnamed key of* its owner.

**Locations use the real client address,** not Elastic's own network hops. *Hover the ⓘ beside a panel title for details.*

config.title: Project
config.esql_query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY project.name | WHERE project.name IS NOT NULL | EVAL project = project.name | FORK (STATS n = SUM(n) BY project) (STATS n = COUNT(*) | EVAL project = "Any", n = 9223372036854775807) | SORT n DESC | LIMIT 10000 | KEEP project

config.title: Identity type
config.esql_query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.domain, user.name, failed_signin = event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") | EVAL identity_kind = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, "Person", api_key.name IS NOT NULL, "Elasticsearch API key", user.domain == "_es_api_key", "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)", user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "Cloud API key", user.domain == "_service_account", "Service account", failed_signin, "Failed sign-in", user.name IS NULL, "Unattributed", "Other") | FORK (STATS n = SUM(n) BY identity_kind) (STATS n = COUNT(*) | EVAL identity_kind = "Any", n = 9223372036854775807) | SORT n DESC | LIMIT 10000 | KEEP identity_kind

config.title: Identity
config.esql_query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY user.email, api_key.name, user.domain, user.name, failed_signin = event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") | EVAL identity_kind = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, "Person", api_key.name IS NOT NULL, "Elasticsearch API key", user.domain == "_es_api_key", "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)", user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", "Cloud API key", user.domain == "_service_account", "Service account", failed_signin, "Failed sign-in", user.name IS NULL, "Unattributed", "Other"), identity = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | WHERE ?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any" OR identity_kind == ?identity_kind | FORK (STATS n = SUM(n) BY identity) (STATS n = COUNT(*) | EVAL identity = "Any", n = 9223372036854775807) | SORT n DESC | LIMIT 10000 | KEEP identity

config.title: Client IP
config.esql_query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY client.ip | WHERE client.ip IS NOT NULL | EVAL client_ip = TO_STRING(client.ip) | FORK (STATS n = SUM(n) BY client_ip) (STATS n = COUNT(*) | EVAL client_ip = "Any", n = 9223372036854775807) | SORT n DESC | LIMIT 10000 | KEEP client_ip
